NAME:
   rancher config add-server - Add a Rancher server entry

USAGE:
   rancher config add-server [options] <name>

OPTIONS:
   --cacert path  PEM CA bundle, a path or the literal PEM
   --help, -h     show help
   --url url      Rancher server url (scheme required)

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
